leadValue.description: The number or word of a time-led row's lead, such as `45` or `9:30`, drawn large. Pair it with `leadUnit`. Ignored when a `lead` snippet is given. A range of times never goes here.

leadUnit.description: The small unit under the lead number, from a closed vocabulary. Used with `leadValue`.

urgency.description: How pressing the lead is. `urgent` uses the warning text colour and `soon` is muted; left unset, the lead uses the default text colour. Used with `leadValue`.

staleAge.description: A short age, such as `3d`, drawn with a gray clock before the trailing value. Give it only when the row's information is stale; a fresh row draws no marker.

chevron.description: Draws a trailing chevron. Left unset, a row with `href` draws one.

selected.description: Marks the row as the current one with a tint.

suggested.description:
Marks the row as a suggestion that is not saved until the person confirms it: a quiet accent
text label on a line above the title, with no tint, border or pill.

suggestedLabel.description: The words of the suggested label, such as "Suggested wording". Used with `suggested`.

href.description: Makes the whole row a link to this address.

rel.description: The link's relationship; `noopener noreferrer` is added for `_blank`.

unsupportedProps.name: action
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing action such as a menu button. It sits in a fixed-width column, so a changing value never moves its click target.

unsupportedProps.name: actions
unsupportedProps.description:
Text actions at the end of the row, each a secondary small button (a link drawn as one when it
has `href`), for a row whose action is the point of the row, such as a review waiting on you.
They sit above the row's own link. On a phone (below 640px) they leave the end of the row and
stack full width under its text, never collapsing into a menu, each a 44px target under a
coarse pointer.

unsupportedProps.name: lead
unsupportedProps.description: A fixed-width column for a time or number, such as "45 min left", drawn before the title. Rows in one list line up.

unsupportedProps.name: leading
unsupportedProps.description: A leading icon, thumbnail, avatar or control, drawn before the text.

unsupportedProps.name: photo
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing 56px photo. It reserves no space when absent.

unsupportedProps.name: subtitle
unsupportedProps.description: A secondary line under the title, in muted text. A status is a small dot plus a word here, never a badge.

unsupportedProps.name: title
unsupportedProps.description: The row's main text. With `href`, it becomes the link and the whole row is its target.

unsupportedProps.name: trailing
unsupportedProps.description: A trailing value, such as a count or a short status. It is right-aligned and never moves the action column.
